cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Scientist, Organic Synthetic Chemistry to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Collaboration with cross functional teams (automation engineers, analytical, biology and AI/ML) drive solutions for the development of reaction conditions for the automated synthesis of small molecules.
Troubleshoot, and optimize synthetic routes for rapid generation of complex building blocks.
Optimize organic reactions, work-up and SPE purification for automation in HTS fashion.
Design and test conditions to clean up synthesized compounds on solid phase support, including metal scavenging, as well as develop LC conditions for final product purification.
Design and test protocols for automation system validations.
Continuous automated synthesis of small molecules on HTS fashion.
Design synthetic routes for complex building blocks. Guide, troubleshoot and oversee CROs on the synthesis of the compounds, as applicable.
Support analytical chemists on chromatographic methods development and analytical equipment troubleshooting.
Develop and maintain synthetic chemistry project timeline, and partner with functional leads to coordinate and drive activities.
Drive cross-functional communication and decision-making, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
Report project status and issues to the management and other stakeholders through meetings and key documents.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in Organic Chemistry or related fields with at least 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience.
Strong hands-on background on route scouting for drug candidates' synthesis.
Well versed in metal-catalyzed organic reactions.
Ability for taking initiative, creativity, and innovation in problem solving.
Attention to detail and proactive with excellent follow through.
Ability to work both independently and together with the analytical, automation and biology teams.
Ability to deliver complex objectives under aggressive timelines in a rapidly changing environment.
Ability to consistently generate quality data and manage large databases.
Well versed in analytical technology such as LC (including prep and semi-prep), NMR, LC-MS, KF, etc.
Experience in purification by column chromatography (manual and automated, such as Biotage or equivalent).
Preferred Requirements
Candidates with a mixed combination of degrees and longer industry experience may be considered. Medicinal / Synthetic organic chemist background.
High throughput screening expertise.
SFC knowledge.
Background on design of experiments (DoE).
Chemistry and AI/ML knowledge.

Collaboration with cross functional teams (automation engineers, analytical, biology and AI/ML) drive solutions for the development of reaction conditions for the automated synthesis of small molecules.
Troubleshoot, and optimize synthetic routes for rapid generation of complex building blocks.
Optimize organic reactions, work-up and SPE purification for automation in HTS fashion.
Design and test conditions to clean up synthesized compounds on solid phase support, including metal scavenging, as well as develop LC conditions for final product purification.
Design and test protocols for automation system validations.
Continuous automated synthesis of small molecules on HTS fashion.
Design synthetic routes for complex building blocks. Guide, troubleshoot and oversee CROs on the synthesis of the compounds, as applicable.
Support analytical chemists on chromatographic methods development and analytical equipment troubleshooting.
Develop and maintain synthetic chemistry project timeline, and partner with functional leads to coordinate and drive activities.
Drive cross-functional communication and decision-making, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
Report project status and issues to the management and other stakeholders through meetings and key documents.
cond_0011.requirements:
Degree in Organic Chemistry or related fields with a minimum of 5 years of demonstrated expertise in the pharmaceutical industry. Candidates with a mixed combination of degrees and substantial industry experience may be considered. Medicinal / Synthetic organic chemist background strongly preferred; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Proven track record and extensive hands-on background in route scouting for drug candidates' synthesis.
Deep knowledge of metal-catalyzed organic reactions is required. Strong expertise in high throughput screening is desired.
Exceptional ability to take initiative, with strong creative and innovative problem-solving skills.
Exceptional attention to detail, proactive approach, and strong follow-through.
Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively with analytical, automation, and biology teams.
Proven ability to deliver complex objectives under aggressive timelines in a rapidly changing environment.
Strong command of generating quality data consistently and managing large databases.
Advanced knowledge of analytical technology such as LC (including prep and semi-prep), NMR, LC-MS, KF, etc. Proficiency in SFC is a plus.
Solid understanding of design of experiments (DoE) is ideal.
Expertise in purification by column chromatography (manual and automated, such as Biotage or equivalent).
Proficiency in Chemistry and AI/ML is a plus.

Collaboration with cross functional teams (automation engineers, analytical, biology and AI/ML) drive solutions for the development of reaction conditions for the automated synthesis of small molecules.
Troubleshoot, and optimize synthetic routes for rapid generation of complex building blocks.
Optimize organic reactions, work-up and SPE purification for automation in HTS fashion.
Design and test conditions to clean up synthesized compounds on solid phase support, including metal scavenging, as well as develop LC conditions for final product purification.
Design and test protocols for automation system validations.
Continuous automated synthesis of small molecules on HTS fashion.
Design synthetic routes for complex building blocks. Guide, troubleshoot and oversee CROs on the synthesis of the compounds, as applicable.
Support analytical chemists on chromatographic methods development and analytical equipment troubleshooting.
Develop and maintain synthetic chemistry project timeline, and partner with functional leads to coordinate and drive activities.
Drive cross-functional communication and decision-making, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
Report project status and issues to the management and other stakeholders through meetings and key documents.
cond_0021.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in Organic Chemistry or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with around 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience (candidates with a mix of degrees and longer industry experience are welcome to apply).
Hands-on background in route scouting for drug candidate synthesis.
Working knowledge of metal-catalyzed organic reactions.
Familiarity with analytical technology such as LC (including prep and semi-prep), NMR, LC-MS, KF, etc.
Experience with purification by column chromatography (manual and automated, such as Biotage or equivalent).
Ability to communicate effectively and work both independently and with analytical, automation, and biology teams.
Willingness to take initiative and apply creativity in problem solving.
Attention to detail and ability to follow through on tasks.
Ability to generate quality data and manage large databases.
Preferred Requirements
Background in medicinal or synthetic organic chemistry.
Exposure to high throughput screening.
Familiarity with SFC.
Background in design of experiments (DoE).
Some exposure to chemistry and AI/ML concepts.

Lead collaboration with cross-functional teams (automation engineers, analytical, biology and AI/ML) to drive solutions for the development of reaction conditions for the automated synthesis of small molecules.
Troubleshoot and optimize synthetic routes for rapid generation of complex building blocks.
Optimize organic reactions, work-up and SPE purification for automation in HTS fashion.
Design and test conditions to clean up synthesized compounds on solid phase support, including metal scavenging, and develop LC conditions for final product purification.
Design and test protocols for automation system validations.
Execute continuous automated synthesis of small molecules in HTS fashion.
Design synthetic routes for complex building blocks. Direct, troubleshoot and oversee CROs on the synthesis of compounds, as applicable.
Guide analytical chemists on chromatographic methods development and analytical equipment troubleshooting.
Own the synthetic chemistry project timeline, and partner with functional leads to coordinate and drive activities.
Drive cross-functional communication and decision-making, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
Report project status and issues to management and other stakeholders through meetings and key documents.
cond_0107.requirements:
Degree in Organic Chemistry or related fields with at least 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience. Candidates with a mixed combination of degrees, and longer industry experience may be considered. Medicinal / Synthetic organic chemist is preferred.
Strong hands-on background on route scouting for drug candidates' synthesis.
Well versed in metal-catalyzed organic reactions is a must. High throughput screening expertise is desired.
Ability for taking initiative, creativity, and innovation in problem solving.
Attention to detail and proactive with excellent follow through.
Ability to work both independently and together with the analytical, automation and biology teams.
Ability to deliver complex objectives under aggressive timelines in a rapidly changing environment.
Ability to consistently generate quality data and manage large databases.
Well versed in analytical technology such as LC (including prep and semi-prep), NMR, LC-MS, KF, etc. SFC knowledge is a plus.
Background on design of experiments (DoE) is ideal.
Experience in purification by column chromatography (manual and automated, such as Biotage or equivalent).
Chemistry and AI/ML knowledge is a plus.

cond_0118.intro: We are looking for a Senior Scientist, Organic Synthetic Chemistry to join our team.
cond_0118.responsibilities:
Collaboration with cross functional teams (automation engineers, analytical, biology and AI/ML) drive solutions for the development of reaction conditions for the automated synthesis of small molecules.
Troubleshoot, and optimize synthetic routes for rapid generation of complex building blocks.
Optimize organic reactions, work-up and SPE purification for automation in HTS fashion.
Design and test conditions to clean up synthesized compounds on solid phase support, including metal scavenging, as well as develop LC conditions for final product purification.
Design and test protocols for automation system validations.
Continuous automated synthesis of small molecules on HTS fashion.
Design synthetic routes for complex building blocks. Guide, troubleshoot and oversee CROs on the synthesis of the compounds, as applicable.
Support analytical chemists on chromatographic methods development and analytical equipment troubleshooting.
Develop and maintain synthetic chemistry project timeline, and partner with functional leads to coordinate and drive activities.
Drive cross-functional communication and decision-making, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
Report project status and issues to the management and other stakeholders through meetings and key documents.
cond_0118.requirements:
Degree in Organic Chemistry or related fields with at least 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience. Candidates with a mixed combination of degrees, and longer industry experience may be considered. Medicinal / Synthetic organic chemist is preferred.
Strong hands-on background on route scouting for drug candidates' synthesis.
Well versed in metal-catalyzed organic reactions is a must. High throughput screening expertise is desired.
Ability for taking initiative, creativity, and innovation in problem solving.
Attention to detail and proactive with excellent follow through.
Ability to work both independently and together with the analytical, automation and biology teams.
Ability to deliver complex objectives under aggressive timelines in a rapidly changing environment.
Ability to consistently generate quality data and manage large databases.
Well versed in analytical technology such as LC (including prep and semi-prep), NMR, LC-MS, KF, etc. SFC knowledge is a plus.
Background on design of experiments (DoE) is ideal.
Experience in purification by column chromatography (manual and automated, such as Biotage or equivalent).
Chemistry and AI/ML knowledge is a plus.

cond_0161.intro: [Company name masked] is seeking an experienced Synthetic Organic Chemist to drive a chemistry AI platform for small molecule therapeutic discovery, from lead identification to lead candidate, on behalf of clients.
cond_0161.responsibilities:
Lead collaboration with cross-functional teams (automation engineers, analytical, biology and AI/ML) to drive solutions for the development of reaction conditions for the automated synthesis of small molecules.
Troubleshoot and optimize synthetic routes for rapid generation of complex building blocks.
Optimize organic reactions, work-up and SPE purification for automation in HTS fashion.
Design and test conditions to clean up synthesized compounds on solid phase support, including metal scavenging, and develop LC conditions for final product purification.
Design and test protocols for automation system validations.
Execute continuous automated synthesis of small molecules in HTS fashion.
Design synthetic routes for complex building blocks. Direct, troubleshoot and oversee CROs on the synthesis of compounds, as applicable.
Guide analytical chemists on chromatographic methods development and analytical equipment troubleshooting.
Own the synthetic chemistry project timeline, and partner with functional leads to coordinate and drive activities.
Drive cross-functional communication and decision-making, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
Report project status and issues to management and other stakeholders through meetings and key documents.
cond_0161.requirements:
Degree in Organic Chemistry or related fields with at least 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience. Candidates with a mixed combination of degrees, and longer industry experience may be considered. Medicinal / Synthetic organic chemist is preferred.
Strong hands-on background on route scouting for drug candidates' synthesis.
Well versed in metal-catalyzed organic reactions is a must. High throughput screening expertise is desired.
Ability for taking initiative, creativity, and innovation in problem solving.
Attention to detail and proactive with excellent follow through.
Ability to work both independently and together with the analytical, automation and biology teams.
Ability to deliver complex objectives under aggressive timelines in a rapidly changing environment.
Ability to consistently generate quality data and manage large databases.
Well versed in analytical technology such as LC (including prep and semi-prep), NMR, LC-MS, KF, etc. SFC knowledge is a plus.
Background on design of experiments (DoE) is ideal.
Experience in purification by column chromatography (manual and automated, such as Biotage or equivalent).
Chemistry and AI/ML knowledge is a plus.

cond_0317.responsibilities:
Collaboration with cross functional teams (automation engineers, analytical, biology and AI/ML) drive solutions for the development of reaction conditions for the automated synthesis of small molecules.
Troubleshoot, and optimize synthetic routes for rapid generation of complex building blocks.
Optimize organic reactions, work-up and SPE purification for automation in HTS fashion.
Design and test conditions to clean up synthesized compounds on solid phase support, including metal scavenging, as well as develop LC conditions for final product purification.
Design and test protocols for automation system validations.
Continuous automated synthesis of small molecules on HTS fashion.
Design synthetic routes for complex building blocks. Guide, troubleshoot and oversee CROs on the synthesis of the compounds, as applicable.
Support analytical chemists on chromatographic methods development and analytical equipment troubleshooting.
Develop and maintain synthetic chemistry project timeline, and partner with functional leads to coordinate and drive activities.
Drive cross-functional communication and decision-making, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
Report project status and issues to the management and other stakeholders through meetings and key documents.
cond_0317.requirements:
Degree in Organic Chemistry or related fields with a minimum of 5 years of demonstrated expertise in the pharmaceutical industry. Candidates with a mixed combination of degrees and substantial industry experience may be considered. Medicinal / Synthetic organic chemist background strongly preferred; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Proven track record and extensive hands-on background in route scouting for drug candidates' synthesis.
Deep knowledge of metal-catalyzed organic reactions is required. Strong expertise in high throughput screening is desired.
Exceptional ability to take initiative, with strong creative and innovative problem-solving skills.
Exceptional attention to detail, proactive approach, and strong follow-through.
Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively with analytical, automation, and biology teams.
Proven ability to deliver complex objectives under aggressive timelines in a rapidly changing environment.
Strong command of generating quality data consistently and managing large databases.
Advanced knowledge of analytical technology such as LC (including prep and semi-prep), NMR, LC-MS, KF, etc. Proficiency in SFC is a plus.
Solid understanding of design of experiments (DoE) is ideal.
Expertise in purification by column chromatography (manual and automated, such as Biotage or equivalent).
Proficiency in Chemistry and AI/ML is a plus.
cond_0317.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.

cond_0362.intro: We are looking for a Senior Scientist, Organic Synthetic Chemistry to join our team.
cond_0362.responsibilities:
Collaboration with cross functional teams (automation engineers, analytical, biology and AI/ML) drive solutions for the development of reaction conditions for the automated synthesis of small molecules.
Troubleshoot, and optimize synthetic routes for rapid generation of complex building blocks.
Optimize organic reactions, work-up and SPE purification for automation in HTS fashion.
Design and test conditions to clean up synthesized compounds on solid phase support, including metal scavenging, as well as develop LC conditions for final product purification.
Design and test protocols for automation system validations.
Continuous automated synthesis of small molecules on HTS fashion.
Design synthetic routes for complex building blocks. Guide, troubleshoot and oversee CROs on the synthesis of the compounds, as applicable.
Support analytical chemists on chromatographic methods development and analytical equipment troubleshooting.
Develop and maintain synthetic chemistry project timeline, and partner with functional leads to coordinate and drive activities.
Drive cross-functional communication and decision-making, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
Report project status and issues to the management and other stakeholders through meetings and key documents.
cond_0362.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in Organic Chemistry or related fields; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in the pharmaceutical industry. Candidates with a mixed combination of degrees and longer industry experience may be considered.
Proven track record in route scouting for drug candidate synthesis.
Deep knowledge of metal-catalyzed organic reactions.
Extensive expertise in analytical technology such as LC (including prep and semi-prep), NMR, LC-MS, KF, etc.
Exceptional attention to detail and proactive follow-through.
Strong ability to work both independently and in close collaboration with analytical, automation, and biology teams.
Demonstrated ability to deliver complex objectives under aggressive timelines in a rapidly changing environment.
Proven ability to consistently generate quality data and manage large databases.
Significant experience in purification by column chromatography (manual and automated, such as Biotage or equivalent).
Preferred Requirements
Medicinal / Synthetic organic chemist background strongly preferred.
Solid understanding of high throughput screening methods.
Advanced knowledge of design of experiments (DoE).
Proficiency in SFC.
Solid understanding of Chemistry and AI/ML.

Collaborate on the design and testing of conditions to clean up synthesized compounds on solid phase support, including metal scavenging, and help develop LC conditions for final product purification.

cond_0558.requirements:

Strong hands-on background on route scouting for drug candidates' synthesis.
Well versed in metal-catalyzed organic reactions is a must. High throughput screening expertise is desired.
Ability for taking initiative, creativity, and innovation in problem solving.
Attention to detail and proactive with excellent follow through.
Ability to work both independently and together with the analytical, automation and biology teams.
Ability to deliver complex objectives under aggressive timelines in a rapidly changing environment.
Ability to consistently generate quality data and manage large databases.
Well versed in analytical technology such as LC (including prep and semi-prep), NMR, LC-MS, KF, etc. SFC knowledge is a plus.
Background on design of experiments (DoE) is ideal.
Experience in purification by column chromatography (manual and automated, such as Biotage or equivalent).
